Amy Acton

Democratic candidate for Governor and Lieutenant Governor, Ohio · Open seat

Physician; former Director of the Ohio Department of Health

Amy Acton is a physician who served as Director of the Ohio Department of Health. She is the Democratic nominee for Governor of Ohio in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Vivek Ramaswamy and Libertarian Don Kissick.

Where Acton stands

Property taxes
Lists property taxes among the costs she says she would address. She pledges creative solutions, transparency, and working with both parties to lower costs.
Energy costs
Says new data centers are raising utility bills. Pledges that Ohio consumers and other ratepayers will not carry those added costs.
Data centers
Says she would make sure data center costs are not passed on to Ohio ratepayers.
Health care
Lists health care and drug prices among the costs she pledges to lower as governor.
Government transparency
Proposes more required disclosure, campaign finance reform, and open bidding, contracting, and appointment processes.
Labor and wages
Opposes efforts like Senate Bill 5 to limit collective bargaining. Pledges to fight wage theft.
Debates
Declined to debate Ramaswamy in the general election.
